head: AR-RAʿD · THE THUNDER
sub: Sūrah 13 — named after the loudest thing in the sky

head: THAT IS THE ROOM
sub: Weather, voltage, noise — a sky nobody on the ground controls

head: ṬUMAʾNĪNAH
sub: ṭāʾ · mīm · hamza · nūn — the word the English cannot carry

head: GROUND THAT HAS SETTLED
sub: Land that lies low and level — ground that has finished moving

head: SEDIMENT GOING DOWN
sub: Something disturbed coming to rest — not something never disturbed

head: UNTIL YOU ARE SETTLED
sub: Bukhārī & Muslim — bow, rise, prostrate, each one until settled

head: WHAT THE SPINE DOES
sub: Not a feeling — the half-second where every joint stops moving

head: WHERE WE ARE GOING
sub: Where the āyah sits · who it describes · what dhikr means · the name at the end

head: WHY HAS NO SIGN BEEN SENT DOWN?
arabic: لَوْلَا أُنزِلَ عَلَيْهِ آيَةٌ مِّن رَّبِّهِ
sub: Ar-Raʿd 27 — the taunt the famous āyah is answering

head: WHOEVER TURNS BACK
sub: The sentence does not begin at āyah 28

head: NOT A STANDALONE PROMISE
sub: The back half of a description — answering a taunt about signs

head: HEARTS SETTLE
sub: Ar-Raʿd 28 — not: hearts will feel nice

head: SETTLED ON THE WRONG THING
sub: Yūnus 7 — the same word, said of people heading for the fire

head: MORALLY NEUTRAL
sub: A heart coming to rest — the whole question is what it rests on

head: BOTH READINGS LAND HERE
sub: On either reading, the settling is attached to something

head: THE MECHANISM, NOT THE MOOD
sub: Take the second half away and you keep the mood, lose the mechanism

head: SAKĪNAH
sub: sīn · kāf · nūn — a different root, and a different verb attached

head: IT IS SENT DOWN
sub: Al-Fatḥ 4 — the verb used for rain, and for revelation

head: DHIKR HAS A TONGUE IN IT
sub: dhāl · kāf · rāʾ — mentioning, not only remembering

head: AL-DHIKR
sub: Al-Ḥijr 9 — hearts settle by the thing you can open and read

head: SETTLED IS NOT NUMB
sub: Ṭumaʾnīnah is not forced numbness, and the Qurʾān proves it

head: TAKEN TO THE RIGHT ADDRESS
sub: Yūsuf 86 — grief to the right address is not a failure of settling

head: BOUND, NOT FROZEN
sub: Al-Qaṣaṣ 10 — Mūsā's mother still felt every bit of it

head: SETTLING IS NOT STOPPING
sub: It is what lets you move on purpose instead of being moved

head: REACHING INTO THE GLASS
sub: Every intervention you can make is another disturbance

head: THE SILT DOES NOT LEAVE
sub: Nothing has been removed and nothing has been fixed — it settled

head: YOU CAN SEE THROUGH THE WATER
sub: Not the absence of the heavy thing — the heavy thing at rest

head: DO NOT GRIEVE
sub: At-Tawbah 40 — Mount Thawr, pursuers at the entrance

head: THE SETTLING CAME FIRST
sub: Nothing outside the cave improved. It arrived before the rescue did

head: ON AN ORDINARY BAD DAY
sub: What this actually looks like when you are in it

head: SAY SOMETHING
sub: Not: think about Allah harder. Out loud, under your breath, whatever you can manage

head: ṬUMAʾNĪNAH IN SUJŪD
sub: The one moment in twenty-four hours you are required to stop moving

head: TOLD TO STOP RUSHING
sub: Not told to feel more — and it was not prayer until he did

head: NOT A STOP SIGN
sub: Sit with them. Say less than you want to say

head: LET IT BE ITS ACTUAL SIZE
sub: A description of how a heart is built, not a promise that you will feel peaceful

head: IT IS WHAT HE CALLS YOU
sub: Al-Fajr 27 — not something your heart is doing any more

head: MAY ALLAH MAKE YOURS ONE OF THE SETTLED ONES
sub: Thank you for spending this time in Sūrah Ar-Raʿd
